about: R16 (#40): the event policy truth table. One file drives the Rust test (crates/app/src/policy.rs) and the page e2e test (tests/e2e_app/test_event_policy_table.py): one row per combination of docs/event-policy.md section 2. Columns: audible (a click plays) and exportable (MIDI, spikes, Export All) are the same gate as `out`; kept (isKept / edit::is_kept: a re-pick or Re-analyze keeps it); out (hgIsCut / policy::is_out); tempo (a candidate of tempo detection: the same one predicate, no exception); grey (lnGreyHit: the Learn filter's grey). A kept hit that still carries an out mark is a state no document holds (Rust strips the marks on edit, the page guards with !isManual): both tests run their own mechanism over those rows and must agree with the row.
